{{Top|leg}}
The '''bear spider''' was a creature resembling a long, thin, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Bear/Legends|bear]]. It was covered in [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] that resembled hair and had a web-spinning orifice similar to a [[Spider/Legends|spider]]. A nocturnal predator, they lived in caves and spun webs to capture prey.
